meta.name: frontend-ux
meta.description: Frontend UX rules for Ethereum dApps — mandatory patterns for onchain buttons, four-state connect flows, token approval sequences, address display, USD values, and RPC configuration.

copy.tagline: 让以太坊 dApp 的前端交互遵守必备的 UX 模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发以太坊 dApp 的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Make your Ethereum dApp frontend follow essential UX patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building the frontend of an Ethereum dApp

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在编写以太坊 dApp 前端代码时，会强制套用链上按钮、四态连接流程、代币授权序列、地址显示、USD 值和 RPC 配置的固定模式。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或调整以太坊 dApp 前端，涉及钱包连接、代币授权、地址显示等场景时。

say.text: 帮我生成一个钱包连接按钮，带四种状态。
say.note: Claude 会按四态连接流程输出

say.text: 代币授权前先检查已授权额度。
say.note: Claude 会遵循授权序列规则

say.text: 把地址显示成短格式，并标出 USD 价值。
say.note: Claude 会应用地址和 USD 显示规则

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude enforces fixed patterns for onchain buttons, four-state connect flows, token approval sequences, address display, USD values, and RPC configuration when building Ethereum dApp frontends.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to build or adjust an Ethereum dApp frontend, involving wallet connections, token approvals, or address display.

say_en.text: Generate a wallet connect button with four states.
say_en.note: Claude outputs per the four-state flow.

say_en.text: Check approved allowance before token approval.
Display the address in short form with USD value.
say_en.note: Claude applies address and USD display rules.
